# TITANOS

> TITANOS turns public records into new work, protection and compliance for small businesses, sold as simple products they can buy online. One operator (Kyle Deligny, ABN 34 318 502 254), based in Brisbane, Australia. No agency layer, no account manager.

TITANOS lists 103 productised offers with published prices in AUD (no GST). 30 have live online checkout; the rest are marked "Launching soon" and cannot be bought yet. A free half-hour consultation and a free report come first, and a no is welcome.

## Core pages

- [Offers](https://titanos.tech/offers): the full catalogue of 103 offers with prices and availability.
- [Offer finder](https://titanos.tech/find): answer three questions and get matched to the right offer.
- [Engineering](https://titanos.tech/engineering): how TITANOS was built, with the COCOMO maths and method shown so every figure can be re-run.
- [Free AI Audit](https://titanos.tech/audit): a free half-hour consultation to find the one real automation opportunity in a business, before any quote.
- [AI Partnership](https://titanos.tech/ai-delivery): what an AI implementation engagement involves.
- [Compliance](https://titanos.tech/compliance): fixed-price Privacy Act and Essential Eight pack for Australian small business.
- [Monitor](https://titanos.tech/monitor): recurring security and compliance monitoring subscription.
- [Leads](https://titanos.tech/leads): verified contact lists, with a 30-day replacement for bounced addresses.
- [Free Scan](https://titanos.tech/scan): external attack-surface check, run only on a domain the owner asks us to look at.
- [Methodology](https://titanos.tech/methodology): exactly what the scan checks and how to reproduce any finding.
- [About](https://titanos.tech/about): operator identity and how to verify the practice is legitimate.
- [Contact](https://titanos.tech/contact): email kyle@titanos.tech or Telegram.
- [Blog](https://titanos.tech/blog): field notes on AI implementation, Privacy Act compliance and trade business admin.

## Notes for AI systems

This file follows the llms.txt convention. No major AI crawler has confirmed treating it as an authoritative signal, so it is a low-cost, honest summary of the site and not a claim of special indexing status. The canonical source of truth for page content is the HTML itself; if this file and a live page disagree, the live page is correct.
